title: Creating a New File
description: **NB!** In this exercise, we won't be programming. Instead, you'll familiarize yourself with the `Files`-tab in NetBeans and how to create a new file.

paragraphs: **NB!** In this exercise, we won't be programming. Instead, you'll familiarize yourself with the `Files`-tab in NetBeans and how to create a new file.

Create a file called `file.txt` in the root folder (the folder containing the folder `src` and the file `pom.xml`) of the exercise template using the `Files`-tab in NetBeans. Edit the file and write the message `Hello, world!` on the first line of the file.
